verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's workers-sdk includes Wrangler and a dedicated local simulator ('a simulator for developing and testing Cloudflare Workers, powered by workerd') that runs the same runtime engine (workerd) used in production, letting developers test locally with parity to production. Wrangler's dev workflow is well documented and independently corroborated by community praise for the dev experience. Missing for 10: no direct hands-on comparison confirming full feature parity for every binding/service (e.g., some community comments note friction with Node runtime compatibility and self-hosting alternatives), and no explicit benchmark of simulator-vs-prod fidelity beyond vendor claims.
